consents.title: AI lab analysis
consents.body: To read and explain a lab sheet, its photo or PDF is sent to an AI service.
points: Only the lab file and what the explanation needs (age, life stage, medications) are sent; names, mobile numbers and national IDs are removed from text.
If your name or other personal details are printed on the sheet, it is best to cover them before uploading.
The provider may not use this data to train its models.
The result is not a substitute for a doctor's opinion.
You can withdraw this consent at any time in Privacy.

consents.title: Assistant using your profile
consents.body: For more accurate answers, the health assistant may see your age, life stage and medications.
points: Your name, mobile number and national ID are never sent.
You can chat with the assistant without this consent; answers are just more general.
You can withdraw this consent at any time.

consents.title: Help improve Ritme
consents.body: Anonymous, aggregated statistics on how the app is used help us improve Ritme.
points: These statistics contain no health data and nothing that identifies you.
You can withdraw this consent at any time.

consents.title: Chat with the AI assistant
consents.body: The messages and photos you send in a chat are sent to an AI service to answer you.
points: Names, mobile numbers and national IDs are removed from messages before they are sent.
The provider may not use this data to train its models.
The assistant is not a doctor and does not diagnose; in an emergency call 115.
You can withdraw this consent at any time in Privacy.

consents.title: Voice logging
consents.body: Your recording is sent to an AI service to be turned into text and is deleted right after.
points: Neither the audio nor its transcript is stored; only what you confirm is logged.
The provider may not use this data to train its models.
You can withdraw this consent at any time.

consents.title: AI reading of medical documents
consents.body: To fill in a document's fields automatically (such as date, centre and gestational age), its photo or PDF is sent to an AI service.
points: If your name or other personal details are printed on the document, it is best to cover them before uploading.
Fields read from the document are not saved until you confirm them.
The provider may not use this data to train its models.
You can withdraw this consent at any time.
